cells.title: Source
body: Meta AI released Galactica, a scientific language model, with a public demo in November 2022.
The paper and project site presented the model as trained on scientific and technical corpora.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The public demo was withdrawn shortly after release after users reported plausible but false scientific outputs.
This file uses the paper as the primary artifact and records the demo withdrawal as a source gap, because the live demo outputs are no longer available from Meta.

cells.label: Model scope
cells.notice: source-recorded model scope with public-demo note

cells.title: Provenance
body: The file marks verification with gaps because the public demo artifacts are not preserved by the primary source.
